title: Flexera Announces 2024 Partner of the Year Award Winners
author: Globe Newswire
description: Flexera, a technology spend and risk management company, has announced the winners of its annual Partner of the Year Awards. The 2024 honorees, including Capgemini, Noventiq Holdings, Insight Enterprises, NTT DATA, and Deloitte, have been recognized for their exceptional commitment to delivering high-quality solutions and services that drive measurable success for customers.
